role: Implementer of late-bound passive test ports only, in addition to productive L3 candidate
approved_by: Independent verifier p1311_review in message before implementation
additional_write_scope: Only ports/types/visibility guarded by cfg(p1339_observation) in these two owners, after seal; diagnostics and lineage derived fields as required
allowed: Lossless projection of already real requests, replay records, causal identities and context resources; cross-crate access for instrumented L3 lifecycle tests
